name: How can I make my older home more energy efficient during modernization?

mainEntity.name: How can I make my older home more energy efficient during modernization?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make your older home more energy efficient, consider upgrades such as improved insulation in walls and attics, energy-efficient windows and doors, and modern HVAC systems. Sealing air leaks and upgrading appliances can also significantly reduce energy consumption. A decision factor here is prioritizing which upgrades offer the best return on investment for your climate and budget. We can help you identify the most impactful improvements that qualify for available rebates or tax incentives in our service area, maximizing your savings.
